fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that a loan agent collected Rs. 1,85,000 from the complainant for approving a personal loan and then stopped answering calls. The matter was brought to Erode South PS on 2026-08-30, while the incident was placed on 2026-08-29 at approximately 17:25. The online submission was made by Arun Prakash (9000000194). The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100051 as the destination of the transfer. A person named Karthik Shankar, associated with the number 9000000306, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Agent reportedly claimed a guaranteed approval and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: loan fraud, processing fee, evening, receiving account, mobile number, residential colony, suspect
